cards.ex: We managed to land a deal with a major distributor.
cards.exUz: Biz yirik distribyutor bilan bitim tuzishga muvaffaq bo'ldik.
cards.uzDef: Muvaffaqiyatli bitim tuzish, kelishuvga erishish.

cards.ex: The company followed due process in handling the complaint.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya shikoyatni ko'rib chiqishda tegishli tartibga rioya qildi.
cards.uzDef: Qonuniy va to'g'ri tartib-qoidalar bo'yicha harakat qilish.

cards.ex: The sales team did the heavy lifting to secure the contract.
cards.exUz: Savdo guruhi shartnomani ta'minlash uchun og'ir yukni ko'tardi.
cards.uzDef: Ishning eng qiyin va ko'p mehnat talab qiladigan qismi.

cards.ex: After lengthy negotiations, they reached a consensus on the budget.
cards.exUz: Uzoq muzokaralardan so'ng, ular byudjet bo'yicha konsensusga erishdilar.
cards.uzDef: Umumiy kelishuvga, bir fikrga kelish.

cards.ex: They offered a sweetener deal to close the sale quickly.
cards.exUz: Ular sotuvni tez yopish uchun yaxshilash taklifini berishdi.
cards.uzDef: Bitimni yanada jozibali qilish uchun qo'shimcha taklif.

cards.ex: We were prepared to walk away if they didn't meet our demands.
cards.exUz: Agar ular bizning talablarimizni qondirmasa, voz kechishga tayyor edik.
cards.uzDef: Kelishuvdan voz kechish, rad etish.

cards.ex: This service is value-added for our customers.
cards.exUz: Bu xizmat mijozlarimiz uchun qiymat qo'shilgan.
cards.uzDef: Qo'shimcha foyda yoki qiymat beradigan narsa.

cards.ex: The due diligence process revealed some hidden issues.
cards.exUz: Tekshirish jarayoni ba'zi yashirin muammolarni aniqladi.
cards.uzDef: Bitimdan oldin kompaniya yoki shaxs haqida batafsil tekshiruv.

cards.ex: The negotiating teams seemed to be on the same wavelength.
cards.exUz: Muzokara guruhlari bir to'lqinda ko'rinardi.
cards.uzDef: Bir xil fikrda, bir-birini yaxshi tushunish.

cards.ex: This proposal is a viable option for both parties.
cards.exUz: Bu taklif har ikki tomon uchun maqbul variant.
cards.uzDef: Amalga oshirish mumkin bo'lgan va muvaffaqiyatli bo'lish ehtimoli yuqori bo'lgan variant.

cards.ex: They sweetened the deal by offering a discount.
cards.exUz: Ular chegirma taklif qilib, kelishuvni yaxshilashdi.
cards.uzDef: Bitimni yanada qiziqarli qilish uchun qo'shimcha takliflar kiritish.

cards.ex: We had to stand firm on our price to protect our profit margins.
cards.exUz: Daromad marjalarini himoya qilish uchun biz narximizda qat'iy turishimiz kerak edi.
cards.uzDef: O'z pozitsiyasida qat'iy turish, o'z fikridan qaytmaslik.

cards.ex: The merger fell through at the last minute.
cards.exUz: Qo'shilish oxirgi daqiqada amalga oshmay qoldi.
cards.uzDef: Rejalashtirilgan narsa amalga oshmay qolishi.

cards.ex: We need to iron out the differences before finalizing the contract.
cards.exUz: Shartnomani yakunlashdan oldin biz kelishmovchiliklarni bartaraf etishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Fikrlardagi farqlarni hal qilish, kelishuvga erishish.

cards.ex: Our innovative technology gives us a competitive edge.
cards.exUz: Bizning innovatsion texnologiyamiz bizga raqobat ustunligini beradi.
cards.uzDef: Boshqa kompaniyalardan ustunlik beradigan omil.

cards.ex: Their investment in research and development finally began to bear fruit.
cards.exUz: Ularning tadqiqot va ishlanmalarga sarmoyasi nihoyat natija bera boshladi.
cards.uzDef: Muvaffaqiyatli bo'lish, yaxshi natijalar ko'rsatish.

cards.ex: They decided to leave that offer on the table.
cards.exUz: Ular bu taklifni rad etishga qaror qilishdi.
cards.uzDef: Taklifni qabul qilmaslik, rad etish.

cards.ex: Negotiations shouldn't be a zero-sum game; both sides should benefit.
cards.exUz: Muzokaralar nol yig'indili o'yin bo'lmasligi kerak; har ikki tomon foyda ko'rishi kerak.
cards.uzDef: Bir tomonning yutug'i boshqa tomonning yo'qotishi hisobiga bo'ladigan vaziyat.

cards.ex: We need to refine our go-to-market strategy to reach more customers.
cards.exUz: Ko'proq mijozlarga erishish uchun bozorga chiqish strategiyamizni takomillashtirishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Mahsulot yoki xizmatni bozorga chiqarish rejalari.

cards.ex: Let's circle back on this issue next week.
cards.exUz: Keling, bu masalani keyingi hafta muhokama qilamiz.
cards.uzDef: Keyinroq aloqaga chiqish, muhokamani davom ettirish.

cards.ex: The contract specifies the deliverables and deadlines.
cards.exUz: Shartnomada etkazib beriladigan mahsulotlar va muddatlar ko'rsatilgan.
cards.uzDef: Shartnoma bo'yicha bajarilishi kerak bo'lgan vazifalar yoki mahsulotlar.

cards.ex: The optics of this deal aren't good, even if it's technically legal.
cards.exUz: Bu bitimning ko'rinishi yaxshi emas, hatto u texnik jihatdan qonuniy bo'lsa ham.
cards.uzDef: Biror vaziyatning qanday ko'rinishi, jamoatchilik fikri.

cards.ex: Well, you win some, you lose some. It's part of the business.
cards.exUz: Xo'sh, yutqazasiz, yutasiz. Bu biznesning bir qismi.
cards.uzDef: Har doim ham hamma narsada g'alaba qozonib bo'lmaydi.

cards.ex: The contract contains standard boilerplate language.
cards.exUz: Shartnomada standart matn mavjud.
cards.uzDef: Ko'p hujjatlarda bir xil bo'lgan standart matn qismi.

cards.ex: We finally got the green light to start the project.
cards.exUz: Biz nihoyat loyihani boshlash uchun ruxsat oldik.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani qilish uchun ruxsat olish.

cards.ex: We'll address that issue down the line.
cards.exUz: Biz bu masalani kelajakda hal qilamiz.
cards.uzDef: Keyinchalik, kelajakda sodir bo'ladigan narsa.

cards.ex: What's our exit strategy for this investment?
cards.exUz: Bu investitsiya uchun bizning chiqish strategiyamiz qanday?
cards.uzDef: Investitsiya yoki biznesdan chiqish rejalari.

cards.ex: We don't have the bandwidth to take on any new projects right now.
cards.exUz: Hozirda yangi loyihalarni olishga imkoniyatimiz yo'q.
cards.uzDef: Vaqt, resurslar yoki qobiliyatlar, ishni bajarish qobiliyati.

cards.ex: He needs to have some skin in the game to be motivated.
cards.exUz: Motivatsiya olish uchun u manfaatdor bo'lishi kerak.
cards.uzDef: Maqsadga erishish uchun shaxsiy manfaatdorlik, riskni bo'lishish.

cards.ex: Let's move forward with this plan.
cards.exUz: Keling, bu reja bilan oldinga siljiymiz.
cards.uzDef: Rivojlanish, kelishuvga erishish, jarayonni davom ettirish.
